failure_level.instructions: At what mathematical level does this approach fundamentally fail?

criteria.representation_theoretic: Mod-p Galois representations cannot be distinguished from target modular forms.
criteria.geometric_moduli: The moduli space has cusps or positive dimension where heights cannot be bounded.
criteria.cohomological_dimension: Cohomology or Selmer dimension grows uncontrollably with ramification |S|.
criteria.topological_invariance: The topological invariant is blind to integer coordinates and Fermat-Catalan solutions.
criteria.computational_exhaustion: The theoretical approach is sound but infinite cases cannot be covered finitely.

bypassable.instructions: Is there any plausible mathematical modification that bypasses this obstruction without changing the core framework?

criteria.true: Yes, a known variant or refined invariant can bypass this obstruction.
criteria.false: No, the obstruction is intrinsic to the foundational category/machinery used.
